_comment: Harness project configuration. See harness-core/docs/ai-harness-architecture.md Section 9.1 and decision-log.md H-6. The review_paths field is an extension added by H-6.10 and is not in the v2.0 architecture.
_protected_paths_comment: Absolute deny. The PreToolUse hook refuses any write here. Existing platform code that Tone Test has no reason to touch, plus credentials, plus harness governance files.
_review_paths_comment: Halt and ask, rather than refuse. Two groups. The first nine are shared platform files that Tone Test must change, so a blanket deny would block the feature at build plan Task 1; edits here should be study-type dispatch only, routing to a new module, and anything larger means logic is leaking into shared code (H-6.10 control two). The last entry covers the source specification documents, which may need correcting under D-1 and D-2 but should never be rewritten without the operator seeing it.
_review_line_budget_comment: H-6.10 control one. Guidance for the Evaluator and the operator, not enforced by the hook. An edit to a review path adding more than this many lines should be questioned.
_writable_paths_comment: New territory. Tone Test logic lives here and nowhere else.
_forbidden_commands_comment: Stated explicitly because the damage is not reversible. git push origin main violates H-3.5, which reserves promotion to the operator. Force push and history rewriting violate architecture Section 14.2.
_branch_comment: H-3.5. The harness works on task branches and may merge to dev. Only the operator promotes to main.
